claim: IEA estimates global data centres used about 415 TWh of electricity in 2024.
quote: Data centres accounted for around 1.5% of the world’s electricity consumption in 2024, or 415 terawatt-hours (TWh).

claim: IEA estimates data centres accounted for 1.5% of global electricity consumption in 2024.
quote: Data centres accounted for around 1.5% of the world’s electricity consumption in 2024, or 415 terawatt-hours (TWh).

claim: IEA projects data centres will consume around 945 TWh globally in 2030 in its base case.
quote: Data centre electricity consumption is set to more than double to around 945 TWh by 2030.

claim: IEA projects data centres will use just under 3% of global electricity in 2030 in its base case.
quote: Our Base Case  finds that global electricity consumption for data centres is projected to double to reach around 945 TWh by 2030 in the Base Case, representing just under 3% of total global electricity consumption in 2030.

claim: IEA estimates data centre electricity consumption grew around 12% per year globally since 2017.
quote: Globally, data centre electricity consumption has grown by around 12% per year since 2017, more than four times faster than the rate of total electricity consumption.

claim: IEA projects accelerated-server electricity consumption, mainly driven by AI adoption, to grow by 30% annually in its base case.
quote: Electricity consumption in accelerated servers, which is mainly driven by AI adoption, is projected to grow by 30% annually in the Base Case, while conventional server electricity consumption growth is slower at9% per year.

claim: IEA estimates around 20% of planned data centre projects could face delays if electricity grid risks are not addressed.
quote: Electricity grids are already under strain in many places: we estimate that unless these risks are addressed, around 20% of planned data centre projects could be at risk of delays.

claim: IEA projects electricity-related data centre emissions to rise from 180 Mt to 300 Mt by 2035 in its base case.
quote: Emissions from electricity use by data centres grows from 180 million tonnes (Mt) today to 300 Mt in the Base Case by 2035, and up to 500 Mt in the Lift-Off Case.

claim: IEA high-efficiency scenario projects global data centre electricity use of around 970 TWh in 2035.
quote: This unlocks energy savings of more than 15%, with global electricity demand from data centres reaching around 970 TWh by 2035.

claim: IEA headwinds scenario projects global data centre electricity demand plateauing around 700 TWh.
quote: This leads to a plateau in energy demand at around 700 TWh, limiting the growth of the data centre share of global electricity demand to less than 2% in 2035.

claim: NVIDIA claims its GB200 NVL72 reduces energy consumption by up to 25x versus the same number of H100 GPUs for LLM inference; this is a vendor claim.
quote: The GB200 NVL72 provides up to a 30x performance increase compared to the same number of NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPUs for LLM inference workloads, and reduces cost and energy consumption by up to 25x.

claim: NVIDIA claims Vera Rubin NVL72 delivers up to 10x token throughput per megawatt versus GB200 NVL72 at comparable interactivity on Kimi-K2-Thinking; this is a workload-specific vendor claim.
quote: On the Kimi-K2-Thinking workload, Vera Rubin NVL72 delivers up to 10x higher token factory throughput per megawatt than the NVIDIA Blackwell GB200 NVL72 system at comparable user interactivity.

claim: IEA projects data centre electricity consumption in United States increases by around 240 TWh from 2024 to 2030 in its base case.
quote: Consumption increases by around 240 TWh (up 130%) in the United States, compared to the 2024 level.

claim: IEA projects data centre electricity consumption in China increases by around 175 TWh from 2024 to 2030 in its base case.
quote: In China it increases by around 175 TWh (up 170%).

claim: IEA projects data centre electricity consumption in Europe increases by more than 45 TWh from 2024 to 2030 in its base case.
quote: In Europe it grows by more than 45 TWh (up 70%).
